CHUANWEI FIRE

A manufacturing source for fire-water-system components

Fire-water-system products for distributors, trading companies and private-label buyers. Explore our product range, working environment and OEM options.

Fire protection products, from selection to order preparation.

Based in Nan'an, Quanzhou, Fujian, China, we manufacture and supply sprinklers, valves, hose reels and hydrant-system components for distributors, trading companies and private-label buyers.

Our production facilities were established in 2017 and cover 5,000 m², with CNC equipment for component machining.

Working with us

Start with the product you need. Specifications, sample arrangements and order terms are agreed for each enquiry.

  1. Send your requirements

    Share the product, model or photo. Add size, connection, quantity and destination when available.

  2. Compare options and quotation

    Review the required configuration, available documents, price and any sample arrangements. Samples are supplied for a fee.

  3. Confirm the order

    Agree the specification, quantity, marking, packaging and delivery schedule before production.

  4. Production and shipment

    Production and packing follow the agreed order. Shipment details are coordinated with the buyer.

Product documents and certificates

View our management-system certificates and Chinese patent certificate scans. Product approvals and document applicability are reviewed by model and destination market.
